payload.answer: For moist banana bread, use 3–4 very ripe (heavily speckled) bananas, melted butter, brown sugar, and a little yogurt or sour cream, and avoid overmixing once the flour goes in. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 60 minutes and check early; overbaking is the most common cause of dry banana bread.
